name: Mivídeo Intent Finder SEO
author: Mivídeo Promoção Digital de Vendas

sections.description:
Mivídeo Intent Finder SEO helps WordPress users discover long-tail content ideas from real search suggestions before creating new content.

The Lite edition combines Google Suggest, Bing Suggest, A-Z expansion, question and search modifiers, editorial intent classification, priority, potential, a suggested content format, an editorial Score from 0 to 100, and optional Google Trends signals.

The plugin does not claim to provide exact monthly search volume. It uses public search suggestions and relative editorial signals to help users organize and prioritize possible topics.

The most recent successful search is stored separately for each WordPress user. It remains available when the user leaves the screen and returns, until a new successful search replaces it or the cache is cleared.

The results table lets users filter ideas, copy individual results, copy selected or visible results, and export the current selection to CSV.

The Saved Ideas tab is displayed as a preview of the PRO workflow. Saving, organizing, analyzing, editing, and reanalyzing ideas are commercial PRO features and do not run in the Lite edition.

Explore Mivídeo Intent Finder SEO PRO

Read the complete documentation

Lite features

  • Search from a seed keyword.
  • Google Suggest integration.
  • Bing Suggest integration.
  • A-Z keyword expansion.
  • Question and search modifiers.
  • Optional Google Trends beta signals.
  • Search intent classification.
  • Suggested content format.
  • Editorial priority and potential.
  • Editorial Score from 0 to 100.
  • Text and intent filters.
  • Search result cache for 12 hours.
  • Persistent last successful search per WordPress user.
  • Copy one result directly from its table row.
  • Copy selected or visible results.
  • CSV export.
  • No paid keyword API required.
  • No license key required.

PRO edition

The separately licensed PRO edition extends the research workflow with:

  • Saved ideas stored separately for each WordPress user.
  • Used and unused status organization.
  • GEO Opportunity analysis for prioritizing ideas that may work well in generative search experiences.
  • Objective analysis mode that does not depend on AI.
  • Optional analysis assisted by the native WordPress AI environment when available and configured.
  • Actionable suggestions for improving proposed titles.
  • Editing and reanalysis of saved ideas.
  • Filters, sorting, bulk actions, and CSV export for saved ideas.
  • Workflow integration with compatible Mivídeo content-writing plugins, including Post SEO Writer and Reviews SEO Writer, when those plugins are installed and available.

The Lite edition includes a disabled Save ideas control and a Saved Ideas preview so users can identify the workflow provided by PRO without running commercial functionality.

PRO details and purchasing information:

View the PRO edition

Usage instructions:

Open the Intent Finder SEO documentation

Search intent categories

The heuristic classifier may identify ideas as:

  • Informational.
  • Problem/Solution.
  • Product.
  • Local.
  • Comparison.
  • Price/Cost.

Intent classification is an editorial aid and should be reviewed by a human editor before publication.

Google Trends beta

When available, the plugin queries public Google Trends endpoints to classify relative interest signals such as trending, growing, stable, or declining.

Google Trends may limit or block requests from some hosting environments. When no usable data is returned, the plugin keeps the idea and applies a conservative editorial fallback. These labels do not represent exact monthly search volume.

External services

This plugin connects to external services only after an administrator starts a keyword search.

Google Suggest receives the search query, selected language, and selected country so it can return autocomplete suggestions.

  • Service: Google Suggest
  • Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Bing Suggest receives the search query and selected market so it can return autocomplete suggestions.

  • Service: Bing Suggest
  • Terms: https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement
  • Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

When Google Trends beta is enabled, Google Trends receives up to five result terms per request, plus the selected country and language, to return relative timeline signals.

  • Service: Google Trends
  • Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

No license key or paid keyword API is required by the Lite edition.

Usage

Example seed keyword:

frizz

Possible ideas may include:

  • how to reduce frizz.
  • frizz in humid weather.
  • best oil for frizz.
  • product for frizzy hair.
  • how much a frizz treatment costs.

Use intent, trend, Score, priority, potential, and suggested format to decide which ideas should be reviewed first.

The Copy button in each result row copies only that idea. The toolbar Copy and Export CSV actions use selected rows when there is a selection; otherwise, they use all visible filtered rows.

Important notes

  • Suggestions indicate possible searches but do not prove monthly search volume.
  • Intent classification is heuristic.
  • The Score is an editorial prioritization indicator, not a search-volume metric or ranking guarantee.
  • Google Trends integration is beta and depends on service availability.
  • Hosting firewalls or security plugins may block external requests.
  • Caching reduces repeated calls to Google, Bing, and Google Trends.
  • The last successful result is stored separately for each WordPress user.
  • The Clear cache button removes both cached searches and the current user’s stored last result.
  • Saved Ideas, GEO Opportunity, native AI-assisted analysis, and writer-plugin integrations are not executed in the Lite edition.
  • Human editorial review is recommended before using any idea for publication.
sections.installation:
1. In the WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Mivídeo Intent Finder SEO, or upload the plugin ZIP file.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Open Intent Finder SEO in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Enter a seed keyword.
  6. Choose the country, language, result limit, and desired suggestion sources.
  7. Click Find ideas.
sections.faq:
Does the Lite edition require a license?

No. The Lite edition does not include a license screen and does not require a license key.

Does the plugin provide exact monthly search volume?

No. The public endpoints used by the plugin do not provide exact monthly volume. The plugin displays relative editorial and trend signals without inventing volume data.

Is the editorial Score a ranking guarantee?

No. The Score is an editorial prioritization aid based on the available signals. It does not guarantee rankings, traffic, clicks, or conversions.

Why is Save ideas disabled?

Saved ideas are part of the PRO editorial workflow. Lite users can copy individual ideas, copy selected results, or export results to CSV.

What does the PRO edition add?

PRO adds per-user saved ideas, used and unused status organization, GEO Opportunity analysis, objective or optional native WordPress AI-assisted analysis, title-improvement suggestions, editing, reanalysis, saved-idea management tools, and integrations with compatible Mivídeo writer plugins.

Where can I learn more about PRO?

Visit the Intent Finder SEO product page or read the complete documentation.

Does the Lite edition require WordPress 7.0?

No. The Lite edition does not use the native WordPress AI Client and supports WordPress 6.0 or newer.

Does Intent Finder SEO write or publish articles automatically?

No. It helps identify and prioritize possible content ideas. Content creation, fact-checking, editing, and publication remain the responsibility of the site editor.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • Created the WordPress.org-ready Lite edition with the mivideo-intent-finder-seo slug, folder, main file, and text domain.
  • Removed the Settings and License submenus.
  • Removed license validation, saved-idea database operations, GEO Opportunity processing, and native AI dependencies.
  • Added a gradient Upgrade to PRO button linking to the Mivídeo plugin website.
  • Added a PRO notice inside the Saved Ideas tab.
  • Disabled the Save ideas toolbar control in search results.
  • Replaced each row’s Save action with a Copy action.
  • Kept per-user persistence of the last successful search.
  • Kept Google Suggest, Bing Suggest, Google Trends beta, filters, Score, copy, and CSV export.
  • Set the minimum supported WordPress version to 6.0.
  • Added internationalized PHP and JavaScript interface strings using the mivideo-intent-finder-seo text domain.
  • Added external-service disclosures for Google Suggest, Bing Suggest, and Google Trends.
  • Added WordPress.org screenshot descriptions and expanded Lite and PRO documentation.
